Walk me through the boarding procedure of VNA

Vietnam Airlines boarding procedure generally includes these steps:

1. Arrival at Airport: Arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before domestic flights and 3 hours before international flights.
2. Check-in: Proceed to the Vietnam Airlines check-in counter or use online/mobile check-in to get your boarding pass.
3. Baggage Drop: If you have checked baggage, drop it at the designated counter.
4. Security Check: Go through the airport security screening.
5. Immigration (for international flights): Complete immigration procedures.
6. Boarding Gate: Arrive at the boarding gate before the boarding time indicated on your boarding pass.
7. Boarding Announcement: Listen for boarding announcements; priority boarding is given to Business Class, families with children, and passengers needing assistance.
8. Boarding: Present your boarding pass and ID/passport to the staff and board the aircraft.

For specific details or updates, please check your flight information or contact Vietnam Airlines directly.
What do you know about route_international_1

Route_international_1 is the Hanoi ↔ Tokyo (Narita or Haneda) route operated by Vietnam Airlines. It is a scheduled international service connecting Noi Bai Airport (HAN) in Hanoi with Narita (NRT) or Haneda (HND) airports in Tokyo. The frequency is daily or several times per week depending on the route and season.
Tell me about route domestic one

Route_domestic_1 is the Hanoi ↔ Ho Chi Minh City route operated by Vietnam Airlines. It is a high-frequency domestic route connecting the political center (Hanoi - Noi Bai Airport, HAN) and the economic center (Ho Chi Minh City - Tan Son Nhat Airport, SGN) of Vietnam. There are multiple flights per day, with frequency varying by season.
